name: @freegrid/sheet
description: Free, MIT-licensed, spreadsheet-like data grid for the web.

scripts.test: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:types && pnpm build && pnpm test:dist && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm test:e2e:min && pnpm test:walkontable
scripts.test:e2e: node build/build-tests.js e2e && node test/runner/run.js --suite e2e --build dev; node ../../tools/compare-baseline.mjs e2e test-results/e2e-dev-chromium.json
scripts.test:e2e:min: node build/build-tests.js e2e && node test/runner/run.js --suite e2e --build min; node ../../tools/compare-baseline.mjs production test-results/e2e-min-chromium.json
scripts.test:walkontable: node build/build-tests.js walkontable && node test/runner/run.js --suite walkontable; node ../../tools/compare-baseline.mjs walkontable test-results/walkontable-dev-chromium.json
scripts.test:selftest: node build/build-tests.js selftest && node test/runner/run.js --suite selftest
scripts.test:e2e:firefox: node build/build-tests.js e2e && node test/runner/run.js --suite e2e --browser firefox; node ../../tools/check-known-failures.mjs firefox test-results/e2e-dev-firefox.json
scripts.test:e2e:webkit: node build/build-tests.js e2e && node test/runner/run.js --suite e2e --browser webkit; node ../../tools/check-known-failures.mjs webkit test-results/e2e-dev-webkit.json
